description:
“If a segment be cut at random, the rectangle contained by the whole and both of the segments is equal to the square on the whole.”
— Euclid's Elements, BOOK II • PROP. 2 (G.83)

00:00 1 · GIVEN: given segment / A B / cut at random at C
00:13 2 · CONSTRUCT: describe square ⟨ A D E B ⟩ on / A B /
00:18 3 · CONSTRUCT: draw / C F / parallel to / A D /, / B E /
00:24 4 · ASSERT: ⟨ A E ⟩ = ⟨ A F ⟩ + ⟨ C E ⟩ = sq(/ A B /)
00:34 5 · ASSERT: ⟨ A F ⟩ = rect(/ A B /, / A C /), ⟨ C E ⟩ = rect(/ A B /, / B C /)
00:45 6 · ∴: rect(/ A B /, / A C /) + rect(/ A B /, / B C /) = sq(/ A B /)
00:55 7 · COMMENTARY: geometric algebra: a² = ab + ac (with a = b + c)
